answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 61 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in sonnet, queued in pulse, and zenith publishes the wait time. A farm of 56 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3019 identities would post 3752 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
